title.narrative: Microenterprise Financing and Credit Enhancement Project

description.narrative: The Microenterprise Financing and Credit Enhancement Project will expand access to finance for unbanked and underbanked microenterprises through Palli Karma Sahayak Foundation (PKSF), a wholesale microfinance apex and its partner microfinance institutions (MFIs) - partner organizations (POs).

description.narrative: 1. Microenterprises' access to MFI financing increased 2. Commercial sources of funding to MFIs for microenterprise financing increased

At least 100,000 new microenterprise borrowers of PKSF's partner MFIs received loans from this project. Achievement: 141421 Progress/Status: Total 165,616 microenterprise borrowers received loans from this project. Data Source: PKSF annual reports, executing or implementing agency's project completion report, project impact assessment report

At least 56,000 women are economically empowered by the project. Progress/Status: Women receiving support from this project are being economically empowered. The number will be known upon conducting survey on it. Data Source: PKSF annual reports, executing or implementing agency's project completion report, project impact assessment report Actual value:

At least 80% of the new microenterprise borrowers receiving funds from this project are women. Achievement: 85 Progress/Status: About 85% of the microenterprise borrowers who received loan from this project are women. Data Source: PKSF annual reports, executing or implementing agency's project completion report, project impact assessment report

Partner MFIs' borrowings from commercial banks for microenterprise loans increased to TK142 billion as a result of the credit guarantee. Progress/Status: Credit Guarantee Agreement has been signed with 5 banks and 1 finance company for a total loan of BDT 31.50 billion to be disbursed to the POs in the FY 2025-2026. Crore Loan has been disbursed by the banks to the 2 POs. Data Source: TA performance monitoring reports Baseline value: TK 48 billion
